_doc: Long-form end-to-end screens: the scripted 'virtual recruiter' phone screens (one vendor, same flow every time), replayed turn by turn as ONE call so history builds up the way it does live. Each turn may carry a checkpoint `check` (tallied across screens in the scorecard) with `match` / `no_match` regexes and `max_words`. Whole-call checks live in run_suite.py (deflection budget, goodbye only on the caller's goodbye, no reply said 3+ times). Agency/recruiter names are placeholders (public repo); the question wording follows the real calls named in `source`. Add a screen for every new digital-recruiter call: tests/build_cases.py --screen <call_id> prints a draft.
